contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ FL IVL CONSTANTIVS [NOB C] ; R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS

A worn copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine dating to the period 330-335 (Reece period 17). GLORIA EXERCITVS reverse type depicting two soldiers holding two standards. Mint unclear. Obverse description: Laureate, draped, and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: FL IVL CONSTANTIVS [NOB C]. Reverse description: Two soldiers holding two standards.
